# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  # PostgreSQL数据库
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: autocodepro-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME:-autocodepro}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER:-admin}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:-password123}
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./init-db.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-db.sql
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    networks:
      - autocodepro-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${DB_USER:-admin}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s

  # Redis缓存
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: autocodepro-redis
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD:-redispass}
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    networks:
      - autocodepro-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "--raw", "incr", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3

  # 后端API服务
  api-server:
    build:
      context: ./packages/api-server
      dockerfile: ../../Dockerfile.api
    container_name: autocodepro-api
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://${DB_USER:-admin}:${DB_PASSWORD:-password123}@postgres:5432/${DB_NAME:-autocodepro}
      - REDIS_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-redispass}@redis:6379
      - JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET:-your-jwt-secret-key}
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      - API_PORT=8000
      - CORS_ORIGIN=${CORS_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
    volumes:
      - ./generated-projects:/app/generated-projects
      - ./templates:/app/templates
      - ./uploads:/app/uploads
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    networks:
      - autocodepro-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s

  # Web管理界面
  web-dashboard:
    build:
      context: ./packages/web-dashboard
      dockerfile: ../../Dockerfile.web
    container_name: autocodepro-web
    depends_on:
      - api-server
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000/api
      - VITE_APP_NAME=AutoCode Pro
    volumes:
      - ./packages/web-dashboard:/app
      - /app/node_modules
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    networks:
      - autocodepro-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:3000"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # Nginx反向代理
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: autocodepro-nginx
    depends_on:
      - api-server
      - web-dashboard
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
      - ./nginx/conf.d:/etc/nginx/conf.d
      - ./ssl:/etc/nginx/ssl
      - ./logs/nginx:/var/log/nginx
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    networks:
      - autocodepro-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  # 监控服务 - Prometheus
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: autocodepro-prometheus
    volumes:
      - ./monitoring/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--web.console.libraries=/etc/prometheus/console_libraries'
      - '--web.console.templates=/etc/prometheus/consoles'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=200h'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    networks:
      - autocodepro-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  # 监控服务 - Grafana
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: autocodepro-grafana
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS=grafana-piechart-panel
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./monitoring/grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning
      - ./monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards

      - "3001:3000"

      - autocodepro-network

  # 日志收集 - ELK Stack (简化版)

    container_name: autocodepro-elasticsearch
    environment:
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - xpack.security.enabled=false

    depends_on:
      - elasticsearch
    networks:
      - autocodepro-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  kibana:

📋 文档说明

本文档整合了对话历史中所有版本的 OpenAPI 规范和插件配置文件，将分散的多个工具（工作流自动化、插件生成、节点自愈、AI增强、数据集成、行业分析、非遗处理等）完全融合为一个统一的自动化工具。所有功能模块保留完整，同时修复了 Invalid params、API 响应格式、URL 前缀不一致等技术问题。

🎯 版本对比与合并说明

版本 主要特点 融合处理
版本1 (全能智能自动化超级中枢API) 基础文本处理、数据处理、工作流 ✅ 完整保留并融合
版本2 (企业工作流智能编排系统) 30个核心功能模块、异步处理 ✅ 完整保留并融合
版本3 (最终修复版) 全部错误修复、统一网关 ✅ 作为最终基座
版本4 (文化遗产/洛阳专题) 文化遗产处理、洛阳特色 ✅ 完整保留并融合
版本5 (完整参数表) 全部参数定义、类型规范 ✅ 完整保留并融合

# .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  # 1. 代码质量检查
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'npm'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci
      
    - name: Lint code
      run: npm run lint
      
    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test
      
    - name: Upload coverage
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3

  # 2. 构建与安全扫描
  build-and-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint-and-test
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Build Docker image
      run: |
        docker build -t ${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest .
        docker build -t ${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }} .
    
    - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
      uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
      with:
        image-ref: '${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest'
        format: 'sarif'
        output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
    
    - name: Upload security scan results
      uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v2
      with:
        sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'

  # 3. 部署到测试环境
  deploy-staging:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-and-scan
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    environment: staging
    steps:
    - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
      uses: steebchen/kubectl@v2
      with:
        config: ${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG }}
        command: set image deployment/myapp app=${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
    
    - name: Run integration tests
      run: |
        npm run test:e2e

  # 4. 部署到生产环境
  deploy-production:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-staging
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: production
    steps:
    - name: Approval required
      uses: trstringer/manual-approval@v1
      with:
        secret: ${{ github.TOKEN }}
        approvers: 'team-lead,devops-admin'
    
    - name: Deploy to production
      uses: steebchen/kubectl@v2
      with:
        config: ${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG_PROD }}
        command: |
          set image deployment/myapp-prod app=${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
          rollout status deployment/myapp-prod

# .gitlab-ci.yml
stages:
  - lint
  - test
  - build
  - scan
  - deploy-staging
  - deploy-prod

variables:
  DOCKER_IMAGE: $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA
  DOCKER_IMAGE_LATEST: $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest

# 缓存配置
cache:
  key: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}
  paths:
    - node_modules/
    - .npm/

# 1. 代码检查
lint:
  stage: lint
  image: node:18-alpine
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npm run lint
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - coverage/
    expire_in: 1 week

# 2. 测试
test:
  stage: test
  image: node:18-alpine
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npm run test:coverage
  coverage: '/All files[^|]*\|[^|]*\s+([\d\.]+)/'
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - coverage/

# 3. 构建Docker镜像
build:
  stage: build
  image: docker:20.10
  services:
    - docker:20.10-dind
  script:
    - docker build -t $DOCKER_IMAGE .
    - docker tag $DOCKER_IMAGE $DOCKER_IMAGE_LATEST
    - docker push $DOCKER_IMAGE
    - docker push $DOCKER_IMAGE_LATEST
  only:
    - main
    - develop

# 4. 安全扫描
security_scan:
  stage: scan
  image: docker:20.10
  services:
    - docker:20.10-dind
  script:
    - docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock aquasec/trivy image --exit-code 1 $DOCKER_IMAGE
  allow_failure: false

# 5. 部署到测试环境
deploy_staging:
  stage: deploy-staging
  image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
  script:
    - kubectl config use-context staging
    - kubectl set image deployment/myapp app=$DOCKER_IMAGE -n staging
    - kubectl rollout status deployment/myapp -n staging
  environment:
    name: staging
    url: https://staging.example.com
  only:
    - develop

# 6. 部署到生产环境
deploy_production:
  stage: deploy-prod
  image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
  script:
    - kubectl config use-context production
    - kubectl set image deployment/myapp app=$DOCKER_IMAGE -n production
    - kubectl rollout status deployment/myapp -n production
  environment:
    name: production
    url: https://example.com
  when: manual
  only:
    - main

# k8s/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: myapp
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app: myapp
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: myapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: myapp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: registry.example.com/myapp:latest
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
        env:
        - name: NODE_ENV
          value: "production"
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: app-secrets
              key: database-url
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "256Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "500m"
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 3000
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 3000
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: myapp-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: myapp
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 3000
  type: ClusterIP
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: myapp-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: myapp
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70

# workflow-template.yaml
version: '1.0'
name: "数据处理器"
description: "自动处理数据的示例工作流"

# 节点定义
nodes:
  - id: "start_1"
    type: "start"
    name: "开始"
    position: { x: 100, y: 100 }
    config:
      variables:
        input_data: { type: "string", required: true }
  
  - id: "llm_1"
    type: "llm"
    name: "数据分析"
    position: { x: 300, y: 100 }
    config:
      model: "gpt-4"
      prompt: "分析以下数据：{{input_data}}"
      temperature: 0.7
  
  - id: "end_1"
    type: "end"
    name: "结束"
    position: { x: 500, y: 100 }

# 连接关系
edges:
  - source: "start_1"
    target: "llm_1"
    sourceHandle: "output"
    targetHandle: "input"
  
  - source: "llm_1"
    target: "end_1"
    sourceHandle: "output"
    targetHandle: "input"

# 全局变量
variables:
  api_key: { type: "string", secure: true }
  timeout: { type: "number", default: 30 }

工作流：智能客服预处理系统

节点顺序：
1. 开始节点 → 接收用户消息
2. 文本清洗节点 → 清理用户输入
3. 情感分析节点 → 判断用户情绪
4. 紧急度判断节点 → 评估问题紧急程度
5. 分类路由节点 → 分配到对应部门
6. 回复生成节点 → 生成响应
7. 消息发送节点 → 发送给用户

// 文件: yaml_040.yaml
============================================================


输出变量：
  - status: 处理状态
  - message: 结果消息
  - cleaned_text: 清洗后的文本
  - statistics: 统计信息
  - processing_time: 处理时间
  - original_preview: 原始文本预览

输入参数1：
  - 名称：input_text
  - 类型：引用
  - 来源：上游节点的输出变量
  - 说明：接收要清洗的文本

输入参数2（可选）：
  - 名称：strict_mode
  - 类型：布尔值
  - 默认值：false
  - 说明：是否启用严格模式
